"Story @COMMENT_BODY@ Gameplay:
Leo takes a night shift at an isolated 1980s radio tower deep in the woods. Armed with a flickering flashlight, he must survive until 06:00 while battling a claustrophobic atmosphere. As the hours tick by, the radio broadcasts his own breathing and eerie whispers, heavy footsteps echo from the locked upper floor, and a towering silhouette with piercing white eyes (\"The Operator\") begins hunting him through the dark corridors.
​Settings @COMMENT_BODY@ Visuals:
A gritty, low-poly or retro-styled 3D aesthetic featuring flickering fluorescent lights, heavy rain outside, vintage radio gear, and a moody, dark color palette built for maximum tension.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
